readme.markdown:
# govdata-korea-api
Cloudflare Workers MCP server: govdata-korea. REST + MCP (JSON-RPC 2.0). Live: api.lazy-mac.com/govdata-korea

toolsPreview.name: get_exchange_rates
toolsPreview.description: Get KRW exchange rates against major currencies. Optionally filter by currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, JPY).

toolsPreview.name: get_holidays
toolsPreview.description: Get Korean public holidays for a given year (2024-2026).

toolsPreview.name: get_population
toolsPreview.description: Get South Korea population data by region. Based on 2024 KOSIS resident registration data.

toolsPreview.name: get_economic_indicators
toolsPreview.description: Get Korean economic indicators: GDP, CPI, unemployment, interest rate, trade, exchange rates, housing index.

toolsPreview.name: get_business_types
toolsPreview.description: Look up Korean Standard Industrial Classification (KSIC) business type codes.

toolsPreview.name: lookup_postal_code
toolsPreview.description: Look up Korean postal codes by district, city, area name, or postal code number.
